ADDED i2: Tests for {@link SequencesComparator}.

The comparator turns a "before" sequence into an "after" sequence by producing an {@link EditScript edit script} of d
ADDED i3: A {@link CommandVisitor} that replays an edit script onto a working copy of the "before" sequence. After every command has been visited, the working copy should
ADDED i4: Working copy of the sequence being transformed.
ADDED i5: Position in {@link #elements} that the next command applies to.
ADDED i6: Concatenates the current working copy into a single String.
ADDED i7: Resets the working copy to a fresh transformation of the given sequence.
ADDED i8: Drop the element at the cursor; the cursor now points at the next element.
ADDED i9: Insert the new element at the cursor and step past it.
ADDED i10: Leave the element untouched and step past it.
ADDED i11: Source sequences (compared element-by-element against {@link #afterStrings}).
ADDED i12: Target sequences that each "before" string should be transformed into.
ADDED i13: Expected minimum number of modifications to turn each "before" into its "after".
ADDED i14: Splits a String into a list of its characters.
ADDED i15: beforeStrings[i], afterStrings[i] and expectedModifications[i] form one test case each: transforming beforeStrings[i] into afterStrings[i] needs exactly expecte
ADDED i16: Replaying each edit script onto its "before" sequence must reproduce the corresponding "after" sequence.
ADDED i17: The number of modifications in each edit script must match the known minimum for that pair of sequences.
ADDED i18: Applying a known number of random edits to a sequence and then comparing must never yield more modifications than were actually applied: the algorithm finds a s
ADDED i19: A fixed reference sentence built from the alphabet above.
ADDED i20: Fixed seed keeps the random edits reproducible across runs.
ADDED i21: Start from a fresh copy of the reference, then apply editCount random insertions/removals.
ADDED i22: Exhaustive check: for every pair drawn from all Shadok sentences up to length 4, replaying the edit script must transform the first sentence into the second.
ADDED i23: Build every sentence of length 0..maxLength-1 over the alphabet by repeatedly appending each letter to the sentences found so far.
